# check/todo_msg

> todo with messages: todo "why", more...

truck [check](../check.md) · [source](../../../registry/check/todo_msg.pkg)

Like [check/todo](todo.md), followed by a message: any
number of `str` expressions, written one after another.

```
app.pkg:2:3: not implemented yet: PDF export
```

## Syntax

Kind: `statement`

```
todo {m: expr str} [ , {more: expr str} ]*
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `m` | expression | `str` |
| `more` (optional) | expression | `str` |

## Needs

- [std/exprstmt](../std/exprstmt.md)
- [check/fail](fail.md)

## Expands to

This package has no backend: each use is rewritten to the following
source, with `{slot}` replaced by what was written there, and compiled again.

```
check_fail({@pos}, "not implemented yet", "")
check_note({m})
{each x in ,}
check_note({x.more})
{end}
check_stop()
```
